idea-plugin.name: contextWatcher — LLM Context & KV Cache Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
Bridges your IDE editor with the local contextWatcher (cw) daemon.
  • Editor Tab Context Badges: See whether the open file is Fresh 🟢, Stale 🟠, Duplicate 🔁, or Pinned 📌 in the active LLM harness context window.
  • Gutter Line-Range Highlights: Visualizes the exact line ranges read by the agent via read_file.
  • 1-Click Surgical Actions: Evict stale file reads or pin selected code snippets to the high-attention tail without breaking the KV cache prefix.
  • ContextWatcher Tool Window: Live Radix Tree, Treemap, KV Cache gauge, and Firewall alerts right inside IntelliJ.

action.text: contextWatcher: Pin Selection to LLM Context
action.description: Pins the selected code snippet to the high-attention tail of the active LLM prompt

action.text: contextWatcher: Shadow-Dedupe / Evict Stale File Reads
action.description: Replaces older stale or duplicate reads of this file in the LLM context window
